IPC2221_screen.limitation: Traditional screening for long homogeneous traces. This is not a thermal simulation, IPC-2152 qualification, or a manufacturing release.

via_barrel_screen.limitation: The factory tolerance range is an illustrative bound, not verified fabrication data. Equipotential parallel-barrel calculation does not include unequal spreading resistance or inductance. Actual copper rings connect all four vias but do not guarantee equal sharing. Barrel loss alone cannot certify temperature rise.

power_control_review.startup_requirement: Keep U5 asleep or both EN inputs low until VM has stabilized; 470uF reduces maximum startup load further. Confirm startup waveform on prototype.
power_control_review.input_C18: 4.7uF 50V X7R 0805; exact part DC-bias curve not yet verified, >=1uF effective is design procurement target rather than TI stated minimum.
turnoff_limitations: Not immediate zero VM due to C15 storage and motor regeneration.
TPS25910 has no reverse-current blocking in this circuit.
22V IN/OUT absolute maximum requires supply/transient behavior verification.
power_control_review.EN_bias_calculation_note: Internal 10M/16.8M divider is included. Additional +/-1.5uA produces an illustrative conservative margin check; the datasheet bias-current test is specified at EN=2.4V/0.2V, so it is not a proven exact bound at about3V.

pin_fanout_current_sharing.limitation: 1.2A per pin and 2.4A in collector represent the equal-sharing design basis, not guaranteed maxima. Internal package and external fanout/spreading resistances can change current division. The approximately1mm narrow fanout is a local pad connection; the IPC long-trace rule does not independently establish its temperature rise.

risks_retained_from_original: C2/C9 VCP100nF vs TI recommended1uF; C5/C12 AVDD100nF and C6/C13 DVDD100nF vs recommended1uF retained by source constraint.
SP/SN grounded; no motor-current measurement or programmable motor current regulation.
CN3 has four signals and no GND pin; external controller must have a separate common-ground path.
10k-fed BZT52C3V3 low-current operation needs measured enable voltage.
Pin mapping and static connectivity do not establish electrical operation; prototype VGS/SH ringing, temperature, regen and startup tests outstanding.
